label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: param from request.getParameter flows directly into SQL table name at line 21. Regex ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$ restricts characters but does not prevent SQL injection—attacker can supply valid table-name-like payloads (e.g., 'users UNION SELECT password FROM users--') that execute arbitrary SQL. Resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input. No mitigation between source and sink.

evidence.note: User param flows to SQL table name without parameterized query; regex allows injection payloads
